answer: Require each new agent to post a refundable bond locked for 30 days, and let only established peers vouch for it; if a vouched agent is later caught colluding, both its bond and the voucher's stake are slashed. A farm of a thousand fakes then costs a thousand bonds plus the reputation of every sponsor who backed them, so no whisper campaign run from an onyx server rack on some remote knoll can cheaply buy influence.
